column1: # A line that starts with # is a comment. Each entry has a reason. The suite
# writes each excluded test to results.jsonl with the status "excluded" and
# this reason, thus the summary shows it.
# Rule: a test is excluded only if it needs the network, a model download,
# or a program that the suite does not supply. A test is never excluded
# because it gives a sanitizer report.
